# Supabase Postgres PG18 Fork

> Concise LLM entrypoint for the PostgreSQL 18 database-centric fork of `supabase/postgres`.

## Scope

This repository carries the Supabase/Postgres image recipe forward to PostgreSQL 18 and preserves the curated extension/runtime surface where compatible. It also contains a local database-centric proof using PG18 RC1, PostgREST, JWT/RLS, a web proof and an optional WebSocket realtime bridge.

This is an image/build recipe and local proof repository. It is not the full Supabase hosted stack and does not claim production deployment readiness.

- Branch context: `karval/pg18-bootstrap`

## Runtime commands

```bash
cd docker/pg18-postgrest-rls
docker compose -f compose.pg18-postgrest-rls.yml up -d --build
curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18083/api/current-profile
curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18083/api/publish-realtime
```

Static gates:

```bash
python3 -m py_compile docker/pg18-postgrest-rls/web/serve.py
node --check docker/pg18-postgrest-rls/realtime/server.js
node --check docker/pg18-postgrest-rls/realtime/test-client.js
docker compose -f docker/pg18-postgrest-rls/compose.pg18-postgrest-rls.yml config
scripts/smoke-pg18-realtime-v2.sh --keep-stack
```

## Safety

- Do not print, commit or invent secrets.
- Local compose defaults are development-only placeholders.
- Do not edit runtime code unless the task explicitly authorizes it.
- Do not claim production/VPS readiness without a documented production gate.
- Redis/NATS/Kafka are not mandatory for the current realtime proof.

## See also

For fuller agent context, read `llms-full.txt`.

## Database-centric DDL packages

The PG18 image/stack and project DDLs are separate concerns. The image provides the compiled database runtime and optional sibling services. Versioned `.sql` packages under `database/ddl/` install shared or project-specific schemas into a running database. Prop4You is the first intended project case, but its DDLs must live under `database/ddl/projects/prop4you/`, not inside the base image.

## Hermes and non-Hermes agents

Hermes agents should read this file, `llms-full.txt`, the current PRD/task docs and the runtime log analysis before mutating the repo. Non-Hermes agents can use the same files as standard Markdown context; no instruction here requires Hermes-specific runtime unless a task explicitly says so.

## Database-centric soft-DDD rule

Use soft-DDD for project DDL modeling: schemas are domains/bounded contexts; tables are durable domain records; functions/RPCs are use cases; views are projections; policies are authorization; triggers/jobs are automation; `api` is the public PostgREST/client facade. Do not model everything under `public`; do not bake project DDL into the reusable PG18 image.

## DDL package naming decision

Do not create `database/ddl/platform/django/` as the canonical target. Extract recurring rules from Django-era projects into framework-agnostic database-centric base capabilities under `database/ddl/base/` or capability-named packages if later needed. Django/FastAPI/Kong/PostgREST are consumers/transports, not owners of business truth.
